title: Backend artifact manifest (backend-runtime-v1)
description: Machine-readable metadata for a backend release tarball (manifest/backend.json). Declares kind, version, gateway entrypoint, contract majors, capabilities, and provenance so Portal and deploy can install and select backends without special-casing product internals.

schema_version.description: Manifest document schema major. Bump only with breaking changes to this file's shape.

kind.description: Backend product family. Must match the pin's backend.kind.

version.description: Immutable release version string (semver, calver, or tagged product version).

entrypoint.description: Path relative to the archive root of the standard gateway binary. Deploy/systemd invoke: <entrypoint> gateway. Reference value: bin/company-brain-backend.

contract.description: Contract major versions this artifact claims to implement. Align with compatibility pin backend.contract.

runtime_layout.description: Backend home filesystem layout major (v1 = BACKEND_HOME layout in the runtime contract).

relay.description: Relay protocol major expected by this backend.

brain_rpc.description: Brain RPC method-set major implemented by this backend.

capabilities.description: Install-time static claim of runtime capabilities for Portal/deploy feature gating. Expanded catalog, UI affordance map, live discovery (brain.capabilities), and unsupported error states: capabilities.schema.json. This object is a projection (profiles, brain_rpc_methods, optional features).

profiles.description: Named profile bundles shipped with the artifact (v1 requires admin and contributor).

brain_rpc_methods.description: Brain RPC methods this build implements (e.g. brain.ping, vault.read).

features.description: Optional boolean feature flags (cron, models, settings_patch, etc.).

provenance.description: Build provenance. source_repo is required; at least one of git_sha or release_tag must be present.

source_repo.description: Canonical source repository URL or org/name identifier.

git_sha.description: Full or abbreviated commit SHA of the build.

release_tag.description: Release tag when the artifact was cut from a tagged release.

builder.description: Optional CI job, builder image, or pipeline identifier.

config_defaults.description: Optional path relative to archive root of default config (e.g. config/defaults.yaml).

docs.description: Optional path relative to archive root of release notes (e.g. docs/backend-release.md).
